name: Square 67
summary: Square 67 is a community shopping center in the Red Bird area of Dallas, serving local residents with convenient retail and services. Operating daily from 9 AM to 8 PM, the center provides accessible shopping options for the surrounding neighborhoods.

The center draws regular traffic from local residents within a 3-5 mile radius who prioritize convenience and accessibility for routine shopping needs.
description: Square 67 is a community-oriented shopping center located at 2550 West Red Bird Lane in the Red Bird district of southern Dallas, Texas.
